information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule with authoritative constructive provenance. The final call consumes that capsule, directly receives every common input, checks the inherited artifact against visible obligations without reopening its substantive commitments, and emits it as one complete policy.
name: Open-Evidence Constructive Sovereignty
organization: two-call sequential lineage with upstream executable origination and terminal obligation discharge

calls.objective: Reconcile all visible evidence and normative obligations into one complete executable policy capsule and retain explicit provenance for downstream obligation checking.

Consume originate_authoritative_capsule, inspect all common evidence to establish fulfillment of visible obligations, preserve the capsule's substantive policy commitments, and emit its single complete policy.
